title: Trumpet
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- trumpet body -->
  <!-- bell -->
  <ellipse cx="82" cy="50" rx="14" ry="16" fill="#ffcf3f"/>
  <ellipse cx="82" cy="50" rx="10" ry="12" fill="#ffe08a"/>
  <ellipse cx="82" cy="50" rx="6" ry="7" fill="#fff4c4"/>
  <!-- bell rim highlight -->
  <path d="M68 50 Q68 34 82 34" stroke="#fff8dd" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
  <!-- main tube -->
  <rect x="22" y="46" width="48" height="8" rx="4" fill="#ffb62e"/>
  <rect x="22" y="47" width="48" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#ffe08a" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- valve casings -->
  <rect x="34" y="36" width="6" height="16" rx="3" fill="#ffd35c"/>
  <rect x="34" y="37" width="2" height="14" rx="1" fill="#fff0b0"/>
  <rect x="44" y="34" width="6" height="20" rx="3" fill="#ffc94a"/>
  <rect x="44" y="35" width="2" height="18" rx="1" fill="#fff0b0"/>
  <rect x="54" y="36" width="6" height="16" rx="3" fill="#ffd35c"/>
  <rect x="54" y="37" width="2" height="14" rx="1" fill="#fff0b0"/>
  <!-- valve tops -->
  <circle cx="37" cy="35" r="3.5" fill="#ffe98a"/>
  <circle cx="47" cy="33" r="3.5" fill="#fff0a0"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="35" r="3.5" fill="#ffe98a"/>
  <!-- valve stems -->
  <rect x="36" y="28" width="2" height="7" fill="#ffdd66"/>
  <rect x="46" y="26" width="2" height="7" fill="#ffdd66"/>
  <rect x="56" y="28" width="2" height="7" fill="#ffdd66"/>
  <!-- mouthpiece -->
  <rect x="10" y="47" width="12" height="6" rx="3" fill="#ffd35c"/>
  <rect x="8" y="45.5" width="5" height="9" rx="2.5" fill="#ffe98a"/>
  <ellipse cx="8" cy="50" rx="2.5" ry="4.5" fill="#fff4c4"/>
  <!-- tuning slide below -->
  <path d="M30 54 Q30 66 40 66 L58 66 Q68 66 68 54" stroke="#ff9f1a" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M30 54 Q30 66 40 66 L58 66 Q68 66 68 54" stroke="#ffd35c" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- finger hooks / braces -->
  <rect x="30" y="52" width="4" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#ffe08a"/>
  <rect x="62" y="52" width="4" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#ffe08a"/>
</svg>
